result.reason: Section 2.11 appropriately and narrowly extends the licences to affiliates and contractors acting on Corio's behalf, with Corio responsible for compliance. However, the redline does not fully reach the playbook position: the fully paid-up licence in Section 2.2 is not made irrevocable, no protection is added limiting termination of any subscription licence to uncured material breach, and successor transferability remains dependent on unseen Section 14.1 rather than being confirmed here. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions.
